answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and edit distance is 0.749, which is close to the system-prompted range (0.79-0.82) and well above quantized or fine-tuned. KL is 0.304 and top-1 agreement is 0.875, both inside the system-prompted range. The activations also match: layer-2 spike 61.9 (range 31.7-64.0, versus at most 6.1 for the others), onset layer 8, a plateau of about 0.48 from layer 16, final cosine 0.847, effective rank 2.81, and activation-to-logit ratio 1.7. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the huge layer-2 spike and the first-token divergence. Quantized is ruled out by the much larger KL and activation differences. Base is ruled out because every difference is non-zero.
